title: FoundSurface: Feedforward Ray-Based 3D Scene Surface Reconstruction from Unposed Images
abstract: Accurate 3D surface reconstruction from unposed images remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Recent feed-forward pointmap methods eliminate the need for camera poses but inherently produce discrete, sparse representations. In this paper, we present a generalizable pipeline that directly recovers continuous, high-fidelity 3D surfaces from unposed images by seamlessly integrating pointmap- and ray-based representations. Our approach first extracts explicit geometric priors using a pre-trained pointmap model. A query-view-centric selection module then identifies geometrically relevant reference views via a robust surfel voting mechanism. Next, a cross-attention regressor bridges target query rays with reference features to estimate a continuous coarse surface. Lastly, a raylet-based module aggregates local 3D features to carve out high-frequency details and analytical normals. Trained as a single foundation model on 9 diverse datasets, our method demonstrates exceptional zero-shot generalization on 6 unseen datasets, clearly surpassing state-of-the-art baselines in geometric accuracy and detail preservation.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据精确 arXiv 版本 2611.34128v1 的 36 页全文及关键页面核验；数字均为作者报告，未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: FoundSurface把VGGT离散pointmaps接到query-view筛选、ray-distance回归和raylet细化，得到可查询连续surface与解析normal。作者报告ScanNet++的50-view ADE为0.132m，对比PriorDA 0.198m；值得精读离散到连续的接口，但仍继承镜面/透明物体的几何错误，且显存较大。
analysis.motivationZh: Unposed多视图的feed-forward pointmaps离散且稀疏，直接投影难以恢复连续细节。
analysis.methodZh: Unposed多视图的feed-forward pointmaps离散且稀疏，直接投影难以恢复连续细节。VGGT融合4层features并预测几何，以target-view pseudo-depth的surfel voting选top-2 references，在局部坐标用Plücker queries cross-attend features回归粗distance，再以SPConv anchors和raylet residual细化。作者在9个训练集及6个未用于本模型训练的测试集评估，报告ScanNet++ ADE 0.132m、细voxel mesh CD 0.056m；未独立复现。
methodFlow: target-view投影及surfel voting选择top-2 reference views
局部Plücker ray queries cross-attend几何features预测coarse distance
SPConv local anchors → raylet residual → continuous surface/normal
analysis.experimentsZh: 9个数据集训练；评估ScanNet++、7Scenes、MultiScan、Replica、MuSHRoom与Tanks&Temples，常规50 input views，另测5–100 views、single-view邻帧query、normal和mesh。 作者报告ScanNet++ 50-view ADE 0.132m，PriorDA为0.198m。 (Table 1, p. 6) 作者报告ScanNet++ mesh CD 0.056m、F1@10cm 0.910，使用voxel 0.01。 (Table 9, p. 10) 比较VGGT projection、PriorDA、CUT3R、FLARE和相同pointmaps上重训的RayletDF；另有TSDF/Poisson/NKSR及PGSR。不同baseline训练/backbone不完全一致。 移除surfel voting、hierarchical features、local coordinates、reference filtering及refinement；ablation仅用ScanNet训练，MuSHRoom上local coordinates和top-k影响较明显，不能等同完整多数据集训练消融。
analysis.insightZh: 新意是query-view surfel selection、局部ray regressor与raylet refinement的集成，把成熟pointmap prior转为连续查询；不是新pointmap backbone或任意资产生成器。
analysis.evidenceZh: 以query-view selection连接pointmap和continuous ray field。 (Secs. 3.1–3.4, Fig. 3, pp. 3–6) top-2 views、local coordinates和raylet residual是核心机制。 作者报告50-view ScanNet++ ADE 0.132m，PriorDA为0.198m。 (Table 1, p. 6; Sec. 4.1, p. 7) 度量是ray-surface distance，并非生成资产质量。 细voxel输出改善mesh CD，仍不逐项统治所有指标。 (Table 9, p. 10) voxel 0.01的CD为0.056、F1@10cm为0.910。 geometry prior错误及backbone成本仍限制系统。 (Limitations, p. 10; Table 10, p. 18; Fig. 13, p. 28) 镜面/玻璃失败可见；报告20.89GB、8.68FPS的50-view 640×480配置。
analysis.caveatZh: 模型依赖大pretrained pointmap backbone，移动部署待优化。 镜面和透明玻璃可让VGGT点图失真并传递到surface。 连续ray query不保证watertight或fabrication-ready mesh。 single-view只查询相邻视角，不证明任意360度补全。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 连续surface和normal是3D资产编辑可借鉴的几何接口；尚未验证LEGO、fabrication或生成任务。
